title: The Arrival of COVID-19
text: COVID-19 was first identified in Wuhan in December 2019, however, it did not reach Mexico until February 2020, when it quickly spread across the country. During the first months of the pandemic, public health restrictions were introduced as the number of reported cases increased steadily. The year concluded with the beginning of the national vaccination campaign.

annotations.text: Natural vaccination campaign begins as cases keep rising

title: Successive Waves and Mass Vaccination
text: Throughout 2021, Mexico experienced multiple waves of infections, including a large surge at the beginning of the year followed by another wave driven by the Delta variant. At the same time, the vaccination campaign expanded rapidly, becoming one of the country’s main public health strategies.
